rationale: The replication successfully demonstrates the core symmetry-exact mechanism of d-wave altermagnetism (zero net magnetization, conserved spin channels, momentum-dependent splitting with d-wave nodes and C4 antisymmetry) using a minimal tight-binding model. However, the paper is a Perspective/review covering d/g/i-wave altermagnets, material-specific ab-initio calculations, superfluid-3He analogies, and relativistic effects—none of which were attempted. Only the simplest d-wave toy model was built, with no quantitative benchmark from the paper to match. The symmetry checks pass to machine precision, but coverage of the paper's actual scientific breadth is inherently limited.
